const url = new URL("http://localhost:8080/CoreBanHang/api/v1/shopping-cart/checkout");

let headers = {
    "X-TOKEN-ACCESS": "ijCCtggxLEkG3Yg8hNKZJvMM4EA1Rw4VjVvyIOb7",

    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

let body = JSON.stringify({
    "id[]": "1",
    "discount_code": "p_VL_H1vWUOP",
    "order[payment_method]": ""1"",
    "order[email]": ""example@example.com"",
    "order[province_id]": "1",
    "order[district_id]": "10",
    "order[ward_id]": "100",
    "order[fullname]": ""Nguyen Van A"",
    "order[address]": ""123 Nguyen Trai, Ha Noi"",
    "order[phone]": ""0123456789"",
    "order[note]": "8ISZIc7uTv]<",
    "order[name_other]": "=K\cB|S'^+xz",
    "order[address_other]": "Xnv1Z]3Fv:V>",
    "order[phone_other]": "Ka"%#Zi{6fVY",
    "order[note_other]": "/VG-T>7_M'ab",
})

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: headers,
    body: body
})
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(json => console.log(json));
